recABS9cTyYGHFXEG.Body: The Sonic Slider is the flagship tool behind Biofield Tuning itself, a weighted tuning fork hand-tuned to 93.96 Hz, the twelfth harmonic of the Schumann Resonance, Earth's own natural electromagnetic pulse. Its extended handle lets you glide it smoothly across the face, neck, and body, and practitioners and users regularly report support for relaxation, circulation, and nervous system regulation. It's the same fork Chance uses in his own sessions, and a great entry point if you want to bring this work into your own daily routine.

His supplements are formulated with a focus on bioavailability, so the body can actually absorb and use what you're taking rather than letting it pass through unused. It's a simple, no-nonsense approach to filling the nutritional gaps most modern diets leave behind.

rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Bio: Chance Garton is the host and producer of the Innerverse Podcast, where for over a decade he has investigated consciousness, mythology, symbolism, terrain health, and the psychosomatic language of the human body and mind. A biofield tuning practitioner, he uses tuning forks to help clients resolve physical symptoms, break negative patterns, and return to energetic coherence.
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Name: Chance Garton
rec7Vm5QNrDbc9sdb.Role: Host of the Innerverse Podcast, biofield tuning practitioner & researcher

rec7W1wTqYkkXHLsz.Bio: Topher Gardner hosts the BioCharisma Podcast, blending permaculture, alternative construction, and body work in his exploration of resilience and wellness.
rec7W1wTqYkkXHLsz.Name: Topher Gardner

recfxAFUVToDaUJoB.Bio: Owen Benjamin is a stand-up comedian who was de-platformed from mainstream entertainment and media and rebuilt an independent following; on InnerVerse he discussed disengaging from fear-based media, rebuilding his life, and reframing obstacles as opportunity.
recfxAFUVToDaUJoB.Name: Owen Benjamin

fields.Core Themes JSON: [{"title": "Four Years Off Stage and the Noble Savage Special", "body": "Owen Benjamin explains to Chance Garton why he disappeared from comedy. After leaving CAA, Adam Sandler films and work as Vince Vaughn's closing act, he took a stand against the trans kid movement and every club and theater he booked got a call a week before the date. His answer was Beartaria, crowdfunded land in the Ozarks, where he pitched a tent and taped Noble Savage for fifteen hundred people. He sold the special for three days, made over thirty grand, then refunded every buyer after a dispute with his camera operator and released it free."}, {"title": "Victim Consciousness and the World You Manifest", "body": "Chance, who practices biofield tuning, argues that a heavily traumatized person keeps meeting the same pattern because their expectation writes the script. If you believe life is happening to you rather than that you are happening to life, events repeat until the belief feels justified. Both men criticize truthers for externalizing their power onto a capital T they who supposedly rewrote history. Owen adds that trauma breeds control freaks, that his own trust attracted a business partner who tried to extort him, and that the coyote is what teaches you to build a fence."}, {"title": "Percival's Four Classes and the End of Mass Entertainment", "body": "Owen brings in Harold Percival's book Thinking and Destiny to argue that people sort into doers chasing bodily desire, traders chasing their appetites, thinkers who follow the mind, and rare knowers touching God consciousness. He says the thinkers are gathering now. Topher Gardner adds that mercenary lowest common denominator comedy kills community inside jokes, which is why niche audiences laugh harder. Owen points at Kohler of Wisconsin, a private toilet company with no debt that owns its whole town, as the model he wants instead of debt financed global fame."}, {"title": "The Eclipse, Navaratri and the Symbolism of the Altar", "body": "Guest astro symbolist Gabriel maps the annular eclipse week onto Aleister Crowley's October twelfth birthday, the opening scene of Alan Moore's Watchmen, Nietzsche's birthday and the nine days of Navaratri, which end on United Nations Day. He reads Plato's Symposium as an Enneagram, with the lawyer raising pederasty, the comedian Aristophanes struck speechless by hypocrisy, and Socrates holding the question mark in seat seven. He then traces the Ara altar constellation through the melted beam of the September eleventh footage, The Princess Bride sword fight, and the outlines of North and South America."}, {"title": "Curses, Biocharisma and Psychic Self Defense", "body": "The back half turns to hands on energy work. Gabriel describes what he calls a curse from a capoeira master in a Denver roda. Topher recalls an elder among the Boruca people in Costa Rica draining him with a look, and later describes collapsing a man's energetic field during a private ceremony. Chance recounts a dart of intent thrown at the back of his head at a party. They call the sum of it biocharisma, offer psychic jamming as a defense, and close on symbolic literacy as psychic self defense."}]
fields.Intro Paragraph 1: Comedian Owen Benjamin joins Chance and mystical bodyworker Topher Gardner for a wide-ranging conversation right after Owen's first comedy special in four years and just days after the October 2023 eclipse. Three different lenses on the same big shift happening in human consciousness right now.
fields.Intro Paragraph 2: In this session: Owen's return to standup and what it took to keep going through four years of being de-platformed, the noble savage as the archetype of someone who lives by their own values rather than the trader's script, the thinking class versus the doing class versus the trader class, the symbolism of the eclipse and the alignment of cultural events around it, manifesting reality through collective focus, energy work and what it really means to project consciousness, the Plato Symposium and the deeper meaning behind ancient ritual roles, and Topher's framework of Biocharisma.
